observed_range: 77.2 - 80.7 over four rounds (three repeats plus one standalone run)

known_failures.note: Ten cases fail on every run. Nine of them are one bug: the model omits the GROUP BY key from the SELECT list, so the answer comes back as unlabelled numbers. Tracked separately — fixing it should move group_by from 30% and lift overall accuracy by roughly 15 points.

floor_rationale: 70 sits ~7 points below the lowest observed round (77.2). The floor detects a regression, not a target: losing any one whole category still trips it (dropping the 5 distinct cases alone lands at 69.6), while ordinary run-to-run variance from a non-deterministic model does not. Raise it when a real improvement lands and record what changed.
